sentences.en: The manager sat on the bench with his arms folded.
sentences.zh: 这位经理坐在长凳上，双臂交叉。

sentences.en: The manager has put him back in the major league.
sentences.zh: 经理又把他送回了主要联赛。

sentences.en: Mr White was the manager of a hotel in Springfield.
sentences.zh: 怀特先生是斯普林菲尔德一家酒店的经理。

senses.zh: 处理者，经理，管理人,干事，理事,〈美〉（政党等的）领袖,策士，干才，干练的人
